description: Round16 SCI-oriented AeroDefect-YOLO matrix: detail-preserving SPD stem, ordinary P2 control, defect-aware P2 branch, and dynamic multi-scale fusion.

metadata_defaults.notes: Round16 keeps the N2 detail-preserving augmentation recipe fixed and tests only SCI-oriented architecture changes.

experiments.name: A1_yolo11n_i800_spd_stem
experiments.title: SPD detail-preserving stem under the N2 recipe

metadata.notes: Tests whether early space-to-depth downsampling preserves micro-defect pixels better than standard stride-2 convolution.

experiments.name: A2_yolo11n_i800_plain_p2_control
experiments.title: Plain P2 small-object head control under the N2 recipe

metadata.notes: Control experiment: confirms whether a generic P2 branch alone is sufficient for aircraft skin micro-defects.

experiments.name: A3_yolo11n_i800_spd_defect_p2
experiments.title: SPD stem plus defect-aware morphology P2 branch

metadata.notes: Main tiny-defect branch: combines detail-preserving downsampling with a P2 morphology gate for round missing rivets, thin scratches, and diffuse rust.

experiments.name: A4_yolo11n_i800_spd_defect_p2_dyfuse
experiments.title: Full AeroDefect-YOLO with dynamic multi-scale fusion

metadata.notes: Full SCI candidate: detail-preserving stem, defect-aware high-resolution P2 branch, and learnable multi-scale neck fusion.
